chunks.title: Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye (Invest in Türkiye) (Invest in Türkiye) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye (Invest in Türkiye) is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Antalya host investment agency & Business Forum Climate Finance WG co-convener. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Facilitating FDI, green industrial zones, clean-tech incentives & MDB/private investor matchmaking across Türkiye's 2053 Net Zero agenda. Source verification: https://www.dailysabah.com/business/energy/climate-finance-investment-talks-to-feature-high-on-cop31-agenda/amp.

chunks.title: Invest in Türkiye Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye (Invest in Türkiye) provides the following climate financing instruments: Investment Matchmaking, Government Incentive Facilitation, Public-Private Pilot Introduction. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 0 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate, Project SPV, Municipality, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: Invest in Türkiye Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye (Invest in Türkiye): Climate-Tech Innovation, Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Zero Waste & Circular Economy. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, Global. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Invest in Türkiye Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Invest in Türkiye's application form: Clear investment & job-creation roadmap in Türkiye; Alignment with Türkiye Green Deal Action Plan & 2053 Net Zero; Verified technology readiness & municipal/corporate pilot scope. Explicit exclusion rules: Non-compliant speculative schemes. Official application portal: https://www.invest.gov.tr/en/pages/home-page.aspx.

chunks.title: Invest in Türkiye Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Investment and Finance Office of the Presidency of Türkiye (Invest in Türkiye) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
